titulo: Conjugate dar in the present subjunctive
subtitulo: Dé, des, demos: a tiny stem, and an accent that tells it apart from de.
regla: Dar has the short stem d- with regular endings: dé, des, dé, demos, den. Dé carries an accent to tell it apart from de.

bloques.texto: **Dar** (_to give_) has regular endings in the present subjunctive, but an irregular and very short stem: just **d-**.
**Yo** and **él / ella / usted** carry a written accent, **dé**, to tell them apart from the preposition **de** (_of, from_). The other forms have no accent.
Tip: **dé** wears a hat so nobody mistakes it for little **de**.

lista.en: Beto wants me to give you money.

lista.es: Es bueno que ==des== tus ahorros a una causa.
lista.en: It's good that you give your savings to a cause.

lista.es: Quiero que ella me ==dé== un consejo.
lista.en: I want her to give me some advice.

lista.es: Conviene que le ==demos== los papeles al abogado.
lista.en: We should give the papers to the lawyer.

lista.es: Esperamos que ==den== folletos en la oficina.
lista.en: We hope they hand out brochures at the office.

lista.es: Ojalá que ustedes ==den== la buena noticia pronto.
lista.en: I hope you share the good news soon.

filas.t: Quiero que me de la llave.
Quiero que me dé la llave.
Es mejor que les dén el dinero.
Es mejor que les den el dinero.
No quiero que me das eso.
No quiero que me des eso.

lista.texto: Another verb with a meaningful accent: [[5229|estar in the subjunctive]].
Negative commands use this form: [[9255|negative tú commands]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I want him to give me the key._
lista.r: Quiero que me dé la llave.

lista.p: **Dar** with **nosotros**: Es justo que le ___ las gracias.
lista.r: Es justo que le demos las gracias.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Don't give him the board._ (tú)
